title: King Oyo of Uganda’s Tooro Kingdom Dies at 34
summary_full: King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV of the Tooro Kingdom, in western Uganda, had been in “critical condition,” the kingdom’s prime minister said.
